donors.evidence: Exact opening sentence of the ‘truthfulness’ clause in a Tablet of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá published as Additional Tablets, Extracts and Talks. Garden had the wrong author and a secondary, edition-dependent page.

donors.evidence: Exact sentence in the 12 April 1912 talk at the Studio of Miss Phillips, New York, in The Promulgation of Universal Peace. Paris Talks 22 October 1911 is ‘The Sun of Truth’ and does not contain this sentence.

donors.reason: Garden text ‘Prayer is the key of the doors of mercy.’ was not found in Paris Talks or elsewhere on the Bahá’í Reference Library. Paris Talks’ last 1911 Paris meeting is 1 December (‘The Last Meeting’); there is no 2 December 1911 talk. Closest official wording is ‘Meditation is the key for opening the doors of mysteries’ (London, 12 January 1913). Cannot be emitted as exact scripture.
